text:
alex: Noticing a spike in rerank 5xx/timeouts starting ~2026-03-16T09:12Z. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms -> 1.9s, gateway 504s and 502s. Customers complaining. Sample request_ids: req_0a1b2c3, req_0d4e5f6. Happens only on /v1/rerank. No config changes on support side. @maria can you grab the gateway logs?

maria: grabbing logs now. seeing a bunch of 'upstream timed out' from gateway -> backend-rerank. Also 429 spikes earlier at 09:11. Could be a throttling/retry storm.

sam: past hour metrics: QPS doubled for rerank route, KV cache hit rate unchanged. autoscaler triggered scale up at 09:13 but it was slow to provision GPUs. Stacktrace from gateway:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream error: timeout waiting for response from backend-rerank (10s)
code=504 request_id=req_0a1b2c3 route=/v1/rerank
```

jess: do we have any retries configured client-side? If gateway is retrying failed backend requests it can amplify load. Also need to check long tail of large document batches.

alex: sample client payload we got from customer (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best laptop for ML dev",
  "candidates": ["doc1...", "doc2...", "doc3...", ... up to 100]
}
```
They are submitting batches of 100 candidates at QPS ~8 -> heavy backend work.

maria: confirmed some requests have candidates=100 and sequence lengths > 1024. Backend model latency spikes for long sequences. Also saw p95 backend exec time 1.2s on scaled instances.

eng-runtime-bot: autoscaler event: scaled dedicated-rerank-pool from 4 -> 8 instances (started at 09:13:22, finished 09:18:45)

sam: autoscale lag means there was a 5-minute window of underprovisioning. Meanwhile gateway retries (2 attempts) caused multiplier effect. We also have gateway timeout set to 10s, backend to 8s which causes 504s. Need consistent timeouts.

jess: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- reduce max candidates per request to 50 (support policy)
- disable gateway retries for rerank route
- increase backend pool warmup/min-size
- temporary 429 throttling on heavy clients

alex: repro steps I ran:
1) run k6 with 10 VUs target 8 RPS hitting /v1/rerank with candidates=100
2) observed 30% 5xx within 60s
k6 command:
```
k6 run --vus 10 --duration 1m script-rerank.js
```
script-rerank.js posts above payload

maria: opened ENG ticket ENG-3456 and assigned to @eng-runtime. linking logs + k6 script + sample request IDs.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260316-73 created, priority=P2, link: https://incident.redwood/in/INC-20260316-73 :eyes:

sam: temporary config pushed: disabled retries on rerank route, gateway timeout raised to 20s, applied 20% client-side rate limit for known noisy api keys. Monitor for 15m.

alex: after changes, error rate dropped to ~2%, p95 back to ~300ms. Customers reporting better behavior. We'll keep ENG ticket open for root cause (improve autoscale, investigate batch sizing suggestions).

jess: follow-up action items:
- eng-runtime: investigate slow warmup and instance provisioning time
- platform: add per-route timeout alignment checks in deploy pipeline
- support: message customers to cap candidates=50 and backoff

maria: adding owners + timeline to ENG-3456. tagging @sam for mitigation notes.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
